Messages.Author: George Tran
Messages.Body:
Quick question.

Two vampire enters combat, both inflicting one point to each other. One
has fortitude, prevents his one point and throws down a Pulled Fangs.
Is this legal?

Messages.Author: The Corrupter
Messages.Body:



Perfectly. Even though the first vampire attempted to inflict 1 damage,
the actual amount was 0 (due to prevention). Pulled fangs can only be
thrown during the press phase, so you still have opportunities to
additional strike more damage at the second vampire, hopefully enough to
avoid pulled fangs.

Messages.Author: Christian Herro
Messages.Body:
This question brings up one I have had recently. 2 vampires are in
combat. The one with fortitude takes a good deal more than he dished
out, perhaps preventing some of it. Anyway, when damage resoultion is
over, there is still more damage done to him this round. So the
opponent throws down a Pulled Fangs. Can this be prevented with
say...Skin of Rock or what have you? If so, are his fangs still
missing? Or did preventing the agg damage prevent his fangs from bing
pulled?

Just one of those many weird questions that may have rulings but I
haven't seen it.

Christian

Messages.Author: L. Scott Johnson
Messages.Body:
Christian Herro <herr...@gold.tc.umn.edu> writes:
>This question brings up one I have had recently. 2 vampires are in
>combat. The one with fortitude takes a good deal more than he dished
>out, perhaps preventing some of it. Anyway, when damage resoultion is
>over, there is still more damage done to him this round. So the
>opponent throws down a Pulled Fangs. Can this be prevented with
>say...Skin of Rock or what have you? If so, are his fangs still
>missing? Or did preventing the agg damage prevent his fangs from bing
>pulled?

No.The Rules Team has ruled that you may only play damage prevention cards
during strike resolution (Because you can play them during Strike
resolution means to the RT that you can *only* play them during the Strike
resolution.) You could use a card in play, however, like Flak Jacket
or what have you.
